UserPromptSubmit.command: takoctl status set working --text "Thinking..." && takoctl progress indeterminate

PreToolUse.command: takoctl status set needs_approval --text "Approval requested" && takoctl notify "Claude requested tool approval" --title "Claude Approval" && takoctl progress pause

Stop.command: takoctl status set done --text "Turn complete" && takoctl notify "Claude finished turn" --title "Claude Code" && takoctl progress clear

SessionEnd.command: takoctl status clear && takoctl progress clear
